title: Correct verified documentation drift and expose unresolved Human Intent gaps across all six AlgoChat libraries
description: Correct verified documentation drift and expose unresolved Human Intent gaps across all six AlgoChat libraries
no_spec_change_rationale: No protocol, API, accepted intent, or implementation behavior changes. Correct factual prose, examples, legacy references and existing source/export inventories in nested language specs; preserve normative requirements that exceed implementation and record their gaps. Root protocol/release contracts remain unchanged. Inline source edits are documentation comments only.
acceptance_criteria: All six library READMEs/spec descriptions and the root protocol/security/implementation/HLD docs reflect current source APIs, formats, platform boundaries, and workflows; current versus historical package/registry/parity evidence is labeled; existing PQ/PSK source/export inventories are documented; all84 accepted hi criteria and their IDs/text remain unchanged with explicit evidence/gap status; strict structural/source/export checks, link/manifest checks and Trust pass without changing library runtime behavior or claiming absolute security/parity. Generated documentation fixes are limited to source links, scope notices, and truthful pending snapshots.
